question: What does the acronym 'GIF' stand for?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Graphics Interchange Format**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Graphics Interchange Format (GIF)** is a bitmap image format that was developed by CompuServe in 1987.
 
• GIFs are widely used on the internet due to their wide support and portability between applications and operating systems.
 
• They support up to 8 bits per pixel, allowing a single image to reference a palette of up to 256 distinct colors chosen from the 24-bit RGB color space.
 
• GIFs can be used for small animations and low-resolution film clips due to their support for animation and transparency.
 
• The format's use of lossless compression means that the image quality is not degraded through the compression process.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• GIF became popular because it was one of the first two image formats commonly used on the web, the other being the JPEG format.
 
• It is particularly well-suited for images with large areas of solid color.
 
• GIFs use the Lempel–Ziv–Welch (LZW) lossless data compression technique to reduce the file size without degrading the visual quality.
 
• Despite the limited color palette, GIFs are a popular format for memes and short animations on social media platforms.
 
• In 2012, the Oxford American Dictionary named "GIF" as the word of the year.
